blocks.text: The Philippine National Police (PNP) has launched a cybercrime probe into a fraudulent Facebook account posing as its chief, while cautioning the public against fake social media profiles impersonating police officials. —Photo from PNP MANILA, Philippines — The Philippine National Police (PNP) ordered a cybercrime investigation into a fake Facebook account using its chief’s identity and warned the public against fraudulent social media accounts impersonating police officials. The warning followed the discovery of a fake Facebook account bearing the name “Jose Melencio Corpus” and using the photograph of PNP chief Gen. Jose Melencio Nartatez Jr. In a statement on […]...
